magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.preview: Sign in to your Jaka Marinko account
magicLink.intro: Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.

bookingConfirmation.subject: Booking confirmed: {service}, {date}
bookingConfirmation.intro: Your booking is confirmed. The calendar invite is attached.
bookingConfirmation.payOnSite: You pay on site, by card or cash.
bookingConfirmation.prepNote: We'll send you a short email on how to prepare.

bookingPreparation.subject: How to prepare for your {service}
bookingPreparation.preview: A few things to do before your test
bookingPreparation.intro: Your {service} is on {date}. To get accurate results:
bookingPreparation.noHardTraining: No hard training in the 24 hours before the test. Easy movement is fine.
bookingPreparation.fasted: Come fasted: nothing to eat for 10 hours before the test. Water is fine.
bookingPreparation.meal: Eat a light meal 2 to 3 hours before the test and drink normally.
bookingPreparation.sleep: Sleep well the night before and skip coffee on the day of the test.
bookingPreparation.bring: Sports clothes and the shoes you train in, a towel and a water bottle.
bookingPreparation.questions: If you're ill or injured, let us know and we'll move the test.

bookingReminder.subject: Tomorrow: {service} at {time}
bookingReminder.preview: A reminder for your booking tomorrow
bookingReminder.intro: A reminder that your booking is tomorrow.
bookingReminder.reschedule: Can't make it? Change or cancel your booking

bookingCancelled.subject: Booking cancelled: {service}, {date}
bookingCancelled.refund: If you paid online, the full amount will be refunded to your card within 5 to 10 days.

bookingRescheduled.subject: Booking moved: {service}, {date}
bookingRescheduled.preview: Your booking has a new time
bookingRescheduled.intro: Your booking has been moved to a new time. Here are the new details.
bookingRescheduled.calendar: The updated calendar invite is attached; open it to move the event in your calendar.

contactReceived.subject: New message from {name}
contactReceived.preview: New message from the contact form
contactReceived.intro: Someone sent a message through the contact form.
contactReceived.name: Name

contactAutoReply.subject: We got your message
contactAutoReply.intro: Thanks for your message. We'll reply within two working days.
contactAutoReply.meanwhile: In the meantime, you can look at the lab tests and coaching packages on the website.

accountDelete.subject: Confirm deleting your account
accountDelete.preview: One more step to delete your account
accountDelete.intro: You asked us to delete your Jaka Marinko account. When you confirm, we delete your profile, consents, health answers and sign-in details for good.
accountDelete.kept: For accounting we must keep a record of past bookings (service, date, price, payment) for 10 years, with your name, email and phone removed.
accountDelete.expires: The link works for {minutes} minutes. Open it in the browser where you use your account.
accountDelete.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Your account stays as it is.

offerFreeTest.subject: A free {service} for you
offerFreeTest.intro: You've been given a free {service}. Pick a time that suits you; the code is already filled in.
offerFreeTest.howTo: You can also enter the code yourself in the last step of the booking. It works once, for this email address.

referralCredit.subject: {amount} credit for your next test
referralCredit.preview: A friend tested with us: here's your {amount} credit
referralCredit.intro: A friend you invited has done their test with us. Thank you! Here is your {amount} credit: enter the code in the last step of your next booking.

giftVoucher.subject: Your gift voucher: {value}
giftVoucher.preview: Your gift voucher is ready to print or forward
giftVoucher.intro: Thank you! Your gift voucher for {value} is ready. Open it to print it or forward the link.

bookingOffers.payOnSiteAmount: You pay {price} on site, by card or cash.
bookingOffers.retestIntro: Your season pack includes two lactate retests. Book each one with its own code by {date}:
